Build a Complete Website

The Final Challenge

You have learned everything you need to build a real website with HTML. Now it is time to put it ALL together.

In this final lesson, you will build a complete, multi-section website from scratch. It will use every major concept you have learned across all 10 modules.

Think of this like a final exam, but better - because you are building something real. A chef does not just learn to chop, boil, and fry separately - at the end, they cook a complete meal using ALL their skills together. That is what you are doing now. You are the chef, and this website is your meal.

What You Will Build

You will build a website for "Safari Adventures Kenya" - a tour company based in Nairobi. The website will have all of these sections on a single page:

  1. Header & Navigation - Company logo, name, and anchor links to each section
  2. Hero Section - A big welcome area with a heading, tagline, and call-to-action
  3. About Section - Company description with a figure and image
  4. Tours Section - Tour packages displayed as article cards in a grid
  5. Testimonials - Customer reviews using blockquote
  6. Pricing Table - A table with tour prices, dates, and details
  7. FAQ Section - Common questions using details/summary
  8. Booking Form - A complete form with all input types, labels, validation, fieldsets
  9. Footer - Contact info with address element, social links, copyright

Skills checklist: This project uses: semantic HTML (header, nav, main, article, section, aside, footer, figure, details, address), headings, paragraphs, text formatting, links, images, lists, tables, forms with validation, labels, classes, IDs with anchor links, responsive meta tag, and CSS styling. Basically everything!

Build It

Here is the complete website. Study it carefully, then modify it to make it your own.
